ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with an approximate 60:40 ratio of low-intensity dark pixels to high-intensity white/cream pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and medial fluke regions are dominated by solid black pigmentation. Distinct, large contiguous white/cream regions are mapped to the lateral half of both lobes. High-frequency black mottling occurs at the interior boundaries of the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped median notch with a calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio relative to the lobe junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire trailing edge. The right lobe (image right) exhibits macro-scale notches (deep valleys) and jagged peaks, while the left lobe shows finer, lower-amplitude serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curve leading to sharply tapered, slightly hooked distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two prominent, roughly circular high-contrast greyish-white clusters located in the black medial area of each lobe. Dense clusters of white barnacles (Coronula diadema) are localized on the extreme distal tips and along portions of the leading edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several dark, unaligned diagonal linear streaks (rake marks) are visible crossing the high-intensity white regions on both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive jagged trauma/notching on the trailing edge of the right lobe. Distinct yellowish-tan discoloration (diatom film) is present across the white pigmented surfaces.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular vertical white linear mark/scar extending from the base of the median notch toward the peduncle junction.
